custody.custody_statement: Database backups, .env files, provider keys, repository tokens, and customer-specific artifacts remain under operator or customer control and are not included in this evidence.

continuity_lanes.label: Database backup
continuity_lanes.summary: Operator must run customer-approved PostgreSQL backup tooling before upgrade or restore rehearsal.

continuity_lanes.label: Environment and credential backup
continuity_lanes.summary: Operator must back up .env and credential records outside source control.

continuity_lanes.label: Restore plan
continuity_lanes.summary: Restore order is documented; real restore execution evidence is not attached in the committed sample.

continuity_lanes.label: Restore validation
continuity_lanes.summary: No customer-controlled restore validation was executed for this safe sample.

continuity_lanes.label: Upgrade plan
continuity_lanes.summary: Upgrade order and validation commands are documented for operator execution.

continuity_lanes.label: Post-upgrade validation
continuity_lanes.summary: No real post-upgrade validation bundle is attached in this committed sample.

continuity_lanes.label: Rollback plan
continuity_lanes.summary: Rollback is a human operator decision and must preserve failed upgrade evidence.

continuity_lanes.label: Handoff evidence
continuity_lanes.summary: Continuity evidence should be attached to readiness history only after operator review.

limitations: This committed sample is not proof that a real database backup, restore, upgrade, or rollback was performed.
Real continuity proof must be generated on the operator-controlled or customer-controlled host.
recommended_next_actions: Run backup and restore rehearsal in a customer-controlled environment before clean continuity claims.
Attach post-upgrade release evidence, hosted readiness, package verification, and readiness history when available.
Keep database dumps, .env files, provider keys, repository tokens, and customer identifiers out of committed artifacts.

operator_review.review_statement: A human operator must confirm that no raw backups, credentials, customer identifiers, private source content, or local-only secrets are present before sharing.
